(Source: Bloomberg)

content: Since John Stankey became AT&T CEO in 2020, the company has streamlined its focus around connectivity and concentrated on developing fiber broadband and 5G wireless networks. title: Japan Reiterates It Cannot Accept 25% Car Tariffs From US

title: Tokyo’s Rising Rents Show Inflation Cycle Deepening for BOJ
content: Apartment rents in Tokyo are rising at the fastest pace in 30 years in the latest sign for the Bank of Japan that the nation’s inflation trend is spreading deeper through the economy.

title: Fitch to Revise Mexico Economy Forecast to ‘Mild’ Recession
content: The Mexican economy will likely suffer a “mild contraction” this year, but less than previously estimated while the downturn is partially offset by better-than-expected prospects in the US, a senior Fitch Ratings executive told Bloomberg News.

title: Trump Says Three or Four People on List to Replace Fed’s Powell
content: President Donald Trump said he has three or four people in mind to succeed Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell when his term expires next year.

title: China’s Maritime Structures Near Japan and Korea Raise Tensions

title: Treasury Close to Deal That Would Make ‘Revenge Tax’ Irrelevant
content: The Treasury Department is nearing a deal that would make the so-called “revenge tax” irrelevant, the agency’s second-in-command said, a development that could bring great relief to Wall Street investors worried about punitive tax measures on foreigners.

title: US Extends Debt-Limit Special-Measures Period Through July 24
content: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told US lawmakers he’s extending the latest period for deploying special accounting measures to keep within the debt limit through July 24, 2025.

title: UK Stuck in Decade of Stagnating Living Standards, Report Says
content: British household incomes are set to stagnate in the 2020s, according to a new report, making it the worst decade for living standards in the past 60 years.

title: Top UK Business Leader Warns Rachel Reeves Not to Hike Corporate Taxes

title: Federal Reserve Releases Plan to Relax Key Bank Capital Rule

title: Czechs See Little Room for Rate Cuts as Inflation Risks Increase

title: Powell Says End of Fed’s Interest Paid to Banks Won’t Save Money

title: Fed’s Collins Favors ‘Actively Patient’ Approach to Rates
content: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins said an “actively patient” approach to monetary policy is appropriate while assessing the impact of tariffs on the economy.

title: Ghana Plans First Sale of Domestic Bonds Since Debt Default

title: US New-Home Sales Drop by Most Since 2022 on Poor Affordability

title: Trump Administration Urges Appeals Court to Back Tariff Power

title: Trump Policies Will Cut Deficits Up to $11 Trillion, White House Economist Says

title: US Firm Backs $760 Million Congo-Rwanda-Burundi Hydropower Plant

title: Swiss Are Still Holding Out for a US Trade Deal Before July 9

title: China Doesn’t Hold Upper Hand Versus US, Biden Official Says
